domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's application for leave. Tracks the request from draft through submission, manager decision, and optional cancellation.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT — request created but not yet submitted; editable by employee
SUBMITTED — request sent to manager for review; immutable by employee except for withdrawal
APPROVED — manager granted the leave; balance deducted; employee may still cancel
REJECTED — manager denied the leave; terminal state; no balance impact
CANCELLED — request withdrawn by employee; possible from DRAFT, SUBMITTED, or APPROVED; if from APPROVED, balance is restored

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories. Each type carries rules about documentation requirements and whether it is paid, which policies and balance checks reference.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — leave type is available for requests
INACTIVE — leave type is disabled; no new requests accepted

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules governing a specific leave type: how many days are entitled, whether manager approval is required, minimum notice period, and accrual caps.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — policy is in effect; governs new leave requests
INACTIVE — policy is disabled; does not apply to new requests but historical requests retain their policy reference

domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee in the organisation. Owns leave balances, submits leave requests, and may act as a manager who approves/rejects requests from direct reports.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — employee is currently employed and eligible for leave
INACTIVE — employee is on extended absence (e.g. sabbatical); leave requests may be restricted
TERMINATED — employment ended; no leave requests allowed

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, consumption, and remaining balance for a specific leave policy within a fiscal year. Deducted on approval, restored on cancellation of an approved request.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — balance is in effect for the current fiscal year; used for sufficiency checks
EXHAUSTED — remainingDays is zero; no further leave of this type can be approved until accrual or new fiscal year
CLOSED — fiscal year ended; balance is archived and a new balance is created for the next year

business_rules: Leave duration in days is calculated as (endDate - startDate) + 1, inclusive of both start and end dates. This count is used for balance deduction, balance sufficiency checks, and policy enforcement everywhere the concept of "days requested" appears. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest day count appears, not only here]
A LeaveRequest can only be submitted (DRAFT → SUBMITTED) if the employee's employmentStatus is ACTIVE.
